about: One entry per project. `id` is permanent; `path` may change.

projects.name: Order Intake
projects.purpose: Reads wholesale orders from the orders inbox, creates them in the POS, and replies with a confirmation.
projects.authority: Standing authorization in Projects/Order Intake/CLAUDE.md:12 (owner, 2026-05-02): create orders up to 200 units per customer per day; larger orders wait for approval.

release.checks: unit tests + dry run against the sandbox POS

projects.recovery: The order ledger prevents duplicate orders; see the project's RUNBOOK.md.

projects.name: Daily Production Plan
projects.purpose: Builds tomorrow's bake plan per location from confirmed orders and par levels and emails it to the head baker.

depends_on.detail: reads the wholesale orders Order Intake created

writes: email: bake plan to the head baker
projects.authority: Routine prompt: read-only toward the POS; sends only to the head baker.
projects.recovery: Re-run the routine; the plan is regenerated from the POS.

projects.name: Review Replies
projects.purpose: Drafts a reply to every new public review; posts replies to 4-5 star reviews and queues the rest for the owner.
projects.authority: Owner decision D-003: auto-post 4-5 star replies; 1-3 star replies need approval.
projects.recovery: Replies can be edited on the review site; the run log lists every reply posted.

projects.name: Permit Tracker
projects.purpose: Tracks food-service permits, inspections and renewal dates for every location.
projects.authority: Renewals are submitted and paid by the owner; Claude prepares them.
projects.recovery: Single copy on disk (no repository yet).

projects.name: Operations records
projects.purpose: This repository: registry, status, queue, procedures and the company instructions.

release.runs_from: working tree; instructions installed by ops.py install

projects.recovery: python tools/ops.py install restores the installed instructions.
